note: v1 has the lowest test error but the worst dev error; choosing it because of its test number would select on the test set, so the final model is v4, the one the protocol selects. v5 and v6 (PHASE R): selection on the 6 dev folds only; v6 has the lowest dev error and is the final model; each test score was computed once.
